scope_summary: One selected AWS account; creates or reconciles one prefixed IAM deployment user, its inline thesis-demo-v2 policy, and one access key.

permission_groups.scope: IAM users named twin2mc-* in the selected account
Inline thesis-demo-v2 policy on the generated twin2mc-* user
Generated user access key and the exact dedicated submitted key when its owner can be proven

credential_cleanup: Delete only the exact submitted access-key ID after proving its IAM user owner.
Record STS provider expiry instead of claiming early revocation.
Return manual_revocation_required when ownership or delete authority cannot be proven.
limitations: AWS root access keys are forbidden.
IAM create operations and caller discovery cannot be fully resource-scoped before the generated ARN exists.
The pack is offline evidence and requires IAM Access Analyzer plus a separately approved live validation.
